classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate one small de novo soluble protein candidate with ESM3, perform sequence and structure QC, predict a 3D fold with protenix_v2, and produce a ranked design report.
assumptions: No target sequence, length, or fold class was specified; ESM3 is seeded with an 80-residue all-mask sequence (80 × 'X') for unconstrained de novo generation.
A single generation run (num_steps=20, temperature=0.7) keeps the workflow compact and produces at most one candidate.
ESM3 outputs include a generated sequence string and a protenix_input_json path that the VPA harness forwards directly to protenix_v2.
protenix_v2 runs with n_sample=1 and a single seed (101) for a fast single-candidate structure prediction; MSA and template search are disabled because the sequence is de novo.
msa_backend is set to 'none' because use_msa=false and no MSA exists for a de novo sequence.
Solubility QC is inferred from GRAVY score, net charge, and RSA burial distribution reported by sequence_analysis and structure_analysis; no hard cutoff thresholds were specified by the user.
seq_qc and fold_predict both depend only on esm3_gen outputs and can execute in parallel once esm3_gen completes.
rank_designs aggregates all upstream job outputs and returns top_k=1 to select the single best candidate.
missing_inputs: Target residue length or range (defaulting to 80 aa masked seed)
Desired fold class or functional annotation (defaulting to generic soluble globular protein)
Hard QC thresholds for GRAVY score, disorder fraction, or RSA burial ratio

success_criteria.sequence_generated: ESM3 produces a valid amino-acid sequence replacing all masked positions with canonical residues
success_criteria.sequence_qc_passed: sequence_analysis reports no severe aggregation-prone or transmembrane regions; GRAVY score below 0 (net hydrophilic)
success_criteria.structure_predicted: protenix_v2 returns a structure file with per-residue pLDDT; mean pLDDT >= 70
success_criteria.structure_qc_passed: structure_analysis confirms buried hydrophobic core (RSA < 0.1 for core residues) and solvent-exposed polar surface
success_criteria.ranking_complete: rank_designs returns a ranked table with at least one candidate and aggregated sequence, structure, and QC metrics
